You are building PDF report generation and email notifications for CROBOT (ConvertScan).

**Project path**: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT
**Already installed**: jspdf, jspdf-autotable

## FIRST: Read these files
- `src/types/index.ts` — Scan, PillarResult, Finding types
- `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` — the report page (find the Download PDF button)
- `src/lib/constants.ts` — CRO_PILLARS config
- `src/lib/score-utils.ts` — score colors and utilities

## Part 1: PDF Report Generator

### Create `src/lib/pdf-generator.ts`

Build a function `generateAuditPDF(scan: Scan, pillarResults: PillarResult[], profile: { full_name: string, company_name?: string }) => void`

The PDF should be professional, branded, and data-rich:

**Page 1 — Cover Page:**
- "ConvertScan" logo text at top (use jsPDF text with bold font)
- "CRO Audit Report" title
- URL being audited
- Date of scan
- Overall score displayed prominently (e.g., "67/100")
- Score label: "Needs Improvement" / "Good" / "Excellent" / "Poor" based on thresholds
- Generated by: user name / company name
- "Confidential — Prepared for {company_name}"

**Page 2 — Executive Summary:**
- Overall score with color indicator
- 7 pillar scores in a table: Pillar | Score | Status | Weight
- Key stats: Total issues, Critical issues, Quick wins available
- "Top 3 Priority Fixes" — the 3 highest-impact critical findings

**Pages 3+ — Pillar Breakdown (one section per pillar):**
- Pillar name + score + benchmark comparison
- Each finding as a structured block:
  - Title + severity badge text
  - "Current:" — what was found
  - "Recommendation:" — the fix
  - "AI Suggestion:" — the rewritten alternative (only for non-premium or pro users)
  - Effort + Estimated lift

**Last Page — Quick Wins Summary:**
- Table of all "quick_win" effort findings: Title | Pillar | Estimated Lift | Severity

**Footer on every page:**
- "Generated by ConvertScan — convertscan.com"
- Page number
- Date

Use jsPDF methods:
- `doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')` for headings
- `doc.setFontSize()` for hierarchy
- `doc.setTextColor()` with score colors (hex from score-utils)
- `doc.autoTable()` from jspdf-autotable for tables
- `doc.addPage()` for page breaks
- Track Y position manually, add page when Y > 270

### Wire to AuditReport.tsx
- Read the file, find the "Download PDF" button (it has a Download icon from lucide)
- Import `generateAuditPDF` and call it when the button is clicked
- The scan and pillarResults data is already loaded on the page — pass them to the generator
- Add a loading state on the button (show spinner while generating)

## Part 2: Email Edge Function

### Implement `supabase/functions/send-email/index.ts`

Uses Resend API directly (HTTP, no SDK needed in Deno).

```typescript
import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.168.0/http/server.ts"
```

**Endpoint**: Accepts `{ type, to, data }` where type is one of:
- `welcome` — sent after signup
- `scan_complete` — sent when a scan finishes
- `weekly_digest` — weekly summary (for cron)

**Welcome Email Template:**
```
Subject: Welcome to ConvertScan!
Body: Clean HTML email with:
- ConvertScan logo text
- "Welcome, {name}!"
- "Your account is ready. Start by scanning your first page."
- Big CTA button: "Scan Your First Page" -> {app_url}/scan
- Footer with unsubscribe link
```

**Scan Complete Email Template:**
```
Subject: Your CRO Audit is Ready — Score: {score}/100
Body:
- "Hi {name},"
- "Your audit of {url} is complete."
- Score display: "{score}/100" with color
- "Key findings: {critical_count} critical issues, {quick_wins} quick wins"
- Top 3 findings listed briefly
- Big CTA: "View Full Report" -> {app_url}/reports/{scan_id}
```

**Implementation:**
1. Parse request
2. Build HTML email based on type
3. Call Resend API: `POST https://api.resend.com/emails`
   - Headers: `Authorization: Bearer {RESEND_API_KEY}`
   - Body: `{ from: "ConvertScan <noreply@convertscan.com>", to, subject, html }`
4. Return success/error

The email HTML should be clean, responsive, and professional. Use inline CSS (email-safe). Brand colors: indigo-500 (#6366F1) as accent.

### Wire email sending into analyze-url
Read `supabase/functions/analyze-url/index.ts` and at the end of the pipeline (after scan is marked completed), add a call to invoke the send-email function:
```typescript
// After marking scan complete, send notification email
try {
  await supabaseAdmin.functions.invoke('send-email', {
    body: {
      type: 'scan_complete',
      to: userEmail,
      data: { name: userName, url, score: overallScore, scan_id: scanId, critical_count, quick_wins }
    }
  });
} catch { /* non-critical, don't fail the scan */ }
```

## IMPORTANT RULES
- PDF generation happens CLIENT-SIDE (in the browser) — not a server function
- jsPDF + jspdf-autotable are already installed
- The PDF must look professional — not a text dump. Use proper spacing, colors, tables.
- Email function uses Deno runtime
- RESEND_API_KEY from `Deno.env.get()`
- Email sending is fire-and-forget — never fail a scan because email failed
- Add CORS headers to the edge function
- TypeScript strict, no `any`
